title: Politics Aside with Chris Cillizza
description: Chris goes bowling with journalist Chuck Todd. They discuss the power bar sports have in connecting politicians with the common man. Later, he plays billiards with pool shark and California Congresswoman Laura Friedman.

title: Beyond the Buzzer
description: Wes gives us the inside look at the Wizards' open practice, players serve up some sweet scoops, and Justin Champagnie takes The Wizards Way back to his Brooklyn roots. Plus, Alex Sarr and Kyshawn George surprise each other in an exclusive interview.

title: Hometown With Rachel Nichols
description: The Washington Wizards had a massive, pivotal offseason, and Rachel was on the inside with all the key decision-makers. Now, as a new season gets underway, she drops in on Wizards Media Day, gets to know rookie sensation AJ Dybantsa, and sits down with players to talk about the chemistry that's beginning to take shape.
